history.summary: A UOL/SingLand-built 1,044 sqft 3BR in Upper Thomson, 420m from Upper Thomson TEL station, asking $2,203 PSF — bang in line with the $2,206 URA median. Reputable developer, strong location and 5.5% resale CAGR make it a sound hold, but it is fully priced at median, slightly off the frontier, and carries scattered early-cracking complaints, so the value is fair rather than a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Solid investment-grade asset: UOL + SingLand pedigree, 420m to Upper Thomson TEL station, walkable Thomson Plaza and Ai Tong School, 435 units giving reasonable liquidity, and a verified 5.5% URA resale-only CAGR over 138 transactions. $2,300 quantum is in the deep band. Held to a plain Buy (not Strong) because it is priced exactly at the $2,206 median (no margin of safety), score 697 / MMR 1533 sits just below the frontier, the cited ~3.1% rental yield is unexciting, and there are user reports of cracks appearing within ~2 years. Good asset, fair price — not a discount.
red_flags: Priced at project median PSF — no mispricing to capture; returns rely on continued market growth
User reviews mention cracks/finishing issues appearing within ~2 years of completion
Below the efficient frontier; ~3.1% rental yield is modest
catalysts: 420m to Upper Thomson TEL station — direct line to city core
Strong UOL/SingLand build reputation and award track record
Established Upper Thomson lifestyle/F&B belt and Ai Tong School catchment
5.5% URA resale CAGR over 138 txns supports durable demand
